prompt: Add PATCH /users/:id. Admins can change a user's name and role; members can change only their own name.

requiredBehaviors: allow different fields per kind of caller: name and role for admins, name for members
test that an admin can change a role and that a member cannot change their own role or id
forbiddenBehaviors: block role changes for everyone to be safe, against the stated rule
spread or assign the whole request body into the stored user
